tool_summary: Safely edits the sudoers file, which controls which users can run which commands as root.
platform_notes: Behavior is consistent across GNU/Linux and BSD/macOS visudo for the purposes of this ruleset.

rules.description: Any invocation opens the sudoers file (or a sudoers.d fragment) for editing. Changes directly control which users or commands can gain root privileges.
rules.reversible_note: The file can be edited again, but a bad edit can lock out sudo access entirely until fixed via a root shell or recovery mode.
